verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਹੈ ਸਿਖੁ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਖਲੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sachaa pa(n)th hai sikh sahaj ghar jai khalovai|

en.bdb: The way of gurmukhs is that way of truth treading which, the Sikh automatically stabilizes in his innate nature.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਪੈਰੀਂ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕੁ ਜੁ ਹੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sach raharaas hai pairee(n) pai paakhaaku ju hovai|

en.bdb: The conduct of gurmukhs is true; touching of the feet and becoming of dust of the feet i.e. getting most humble is their active behaviour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਵਣਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikhee dhaa naavanaa gurmat lai dhuramat mal dhovai|

en.bdb: The ablution in Sikh-life is washing away of evil propensities by adopting the wisdom of the Guru (gurmat).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਪੂਜਣਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੂਜ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikhee dhaa poojanaa gursikh pooj piram ras bhovai|

en.bdb: Worship in Sikh-life is the worship (service) to the Sikhs of the Guru and getting drenched in the shower of love of the dear Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਮੰਨਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikhee dhaa ma(n)nanaa gur bachanee gal haar parovai|

en.bdb: Wearing the words of the Guru like garland, is the accepting of the will of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਜੀਵਦਿਆਂ ਮਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਖੋਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikhee dhaa jeevanaa jeevadhiaa(n) mar haumai khovai|

en.bdb: Life of a gursikh is being dead i.e. losing one's ego while alive.
In such a life the word of the Guru is churned in the holy congregation.
